response.summary: I accepted both findings and rejected, modified or deferred none. Both fixes are in the 8.2 handoff sketch in Week 8, with a dated third-review note and one CHANGELOG line. First, a saved pending response now runs even when the model-call cap is reached; the cap only blocks the next model call. Second, `model_context_window_exceeded` now stops the run with `budget`, as Week 2 does, and only `end_turn` counts as a final answer. 25 tests passed. My stub run of the sketch was blocked by the permission check, so I verified both scenarios by reading the code, not by running it. That is the first thing to check.

responses.reason: Correct. Line 223 incremented st.turn before lines 235–236 saved the pending response. If the run crashed on the last permitted turn, st.turn equalled the cap, so on resume the `while st.turn < cap` check stopped the loop before the saved calls ran. The loop condition is now `st.turn < cap or st.pending is not None`. A saved response runs without a new model call. When nothing is pending and the turn is at the cap, the loop exits with turn_cap. The After-a-crash paragraph now says this.
responses.changes: weeks/week-08-multi-agent-systems.md (loop condition, crash paragraph, dated note); CHANGELOG.md

responses.reason: Correct. Any stop reason other than tool_use reached finish().
